The New Orleans Pelicans (4-4, 3-2 at home) host the Minnesota Timberwolves (6-3, 3-2 on the road) in the Pelicans' 9th game of the season, an Emirates NBA Cup West Group B matchup. New Orleans enters on a four-game winning streak and sits 10th in the West, 2.5 games back in the Southwest, while Minnesota is 3rd in the Northwest, 1 game back, and 7th in the West after winning two straight.

Minnesota will be without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), and Terrence Shannon Jr. is day-to-day with a hip bruise and a game-time decision. For New Orleans, Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, and Trey Murphy III is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision.

The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3, most recently a 132-126 loss in Minneapolis on April 12, 2026.
